leadText:
Georgio (Japanese: ツトム Tsutomu) is a character of the day in Pokémon Chronicles, who appeared in A Date with Delcatty!. He is a fairly shy and nice young man who lives in Cerulean City.

Georgio sent a letter to , asking her to meet him at the lighthouse. Upon meeting Misty, who was accompanied by , he asked her to go on a date with him. Misty was taken aback by this and very hesitant to respond, but Georgio challenged her to a battle. If he won, Misty would go with him to the Electabuzz vs. Starmies baseball game, but if he lost, Misty didn't have to date him. Just as the battle began, however, Butch and Cassidy stole his and tried to escape. However, Georgio's , Misty's Corsola, and Casey's Meganium defeated them with relative ease.

After rescuing Delcatty from Butch and Cassidy, Georgio and Misty resumed their battle. Misty narrowly won and promised that she and Georgio would battle again someday. However, Casey wanted to go to the baseball game, and she had to battle Georgio for the ticket. Although Casey and her lost, Georgio still decided to take her to the game as thanks for helping him get his Delcatty back.
